brief.summary_1line: Lakshmana returns to Ayodhya after abandoning Sita and reports to a grief-stricken Rama, urging him to accept destiny and restrain his sorrow.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana bows at Rama’s feet in the palace hall while Rama sits on his throne in visible grief.
Lakshmana arrives at the shining city of Ayodhya at noon, the streets crowded with cheerful citizens while he looks troubled.
Inside the bright palace, Lakshmana with tear-filled eyes clasps Rama’s feet as he confesses leaving Sita near Valmiki’s hermitage.
